messages.subject: Energy Transition & ESG Executive | External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Sustii Team,

Your executive-search focus across energy transition, climate risk, sustainability and clean technology aligns strongly with my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where transition strategy must connect regulation, capital, communities and operational execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
